lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Amy Reyes is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Amy Reyes is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Amy kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Amy's gone." Ella looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Amy." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Apolonia blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Generous Heart (Level 1). Donating gives 2x trust.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Amy Reyes, 40 days. The mantle passes to Apolonia Kubicki.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Apolonia Kubicki, 33 — a comic shop owner. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Amy — and Amy is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Ricardo, Valentina, Mabel and 6 more speak for Apolonia — "Amy trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Apolonia before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
